children: Austin, Texas, United States, September 15th, 2026, FinanceWire

, a leader in innovative, factory-built modular solutions, announced the appointment of Larry King, CPA, as chief financial officer and Heather Clayton as chief accounting officer, strengthening its finance leadership as it builds out the infrastructure of a newly public company. King brings more than 35 years of finance, accounting and operations experience, including extensive SEC reporting, mergers and acquisitions and operational turnaround work, with prior senior roles at Chukchansi Gold Resort & Casino, Riviera Holdings Corp. and Tropicana Entertainment. Clayton brings nearly a decade of experience building and scaling finance and accounting functions for fast-growing, multi-entity organizations, including six years with the Vegas Golden Knights, where she advanced to chief financial officer, and a subsequent CFO role at ASTOUND Group.
To view the full press release, visit https://ibn.fm/etUJw

Since its inception in 2017, BOXABL has raised over $230 million from more than 50,000 investors. The North Las Vegas-based company is dedicated to transforming the housing industry through innovative technology and design, with a mission of making housing affordable at mass-production scale. BOXABL’s flagship product, the Casita, is a 361-square-foot studio unit with a full kitchen, bathroom and utilities that unfolds on-site in under an hour. The Company also offers the smaller 120-square-foot Baby Box and is developing stackable and connectable modules designed to form townhomes, multifamily units, and larger single-family homes. BOXABL began trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol “BXBL” on July 20, 2026, following the completion of its business combination with FG Merger II Corp.
